authority.rule: The Markdown is authoritative. The public DOCX is a sanitized formatting derivative and does not override it.

notes: The user's label 'Fable 5 Max' is retained in surrounding context, but no separate Max model or effort identifier is evidenced in the artifacts.

Token values and some inline payload sizes in the source are estimates, not billing-grade telemetry.

qualifications.qualification: Named entrypoints enabled efficient overview and standards orientation. Exact record hydration later required a guessed path, so the evidence does not establish a guess-free end-to-end journey.
The session reports caveat relay, but n=1 without a raw export or stripped-caveat control does not establish that the format caused the behaviour.
The hydrated record supports an evidence-mapping demonstration. It is not independent DCAT, PROV-O, statistical-product or legal-compliance certification.
Confusable alternatives and reconciliation were available, but the trace does not measure whether they reduce wrong selections.
Fetch truncation was real. Complete dataset chunks are approximately 5.2 to 6.8 MB, not the source document's estimated 0.5 MB. No declared canonical per-record hydration path exists.
The current search contract is browser-oriented and poorly documented for agents. Shards use deterministic token prefixes rather than hashes, and one flat index would itself exceed common fetch caps.
Spooling recovered partial evidence; the browser failure was a client readiness issue, while the empty guessed URL exposed an undeclared hydration contract.
Token economics may be favourable, but the reported token range is estimated and returned partial bytes must not be described as full-resource bytes.
Unauthenticated read-only HTTPS plus scratch storage was sufficient in this session. Required capabilities may differ by client and must be probed.
CPIH is present in the generated central MCP bindings file. The grep miss occurred because the client held only a truncated prefix of that multi-megabyte file.

document_validation.portability_warning: A LibreOffice PDF render on macOS produced 13 pages and clipped top content on several even pages. This known source-layout limitation is preserved in the sanitized derivative; use the Markdown as content authority.

assurance_boundary: This manifest preserves and qualifies research evidence. It does not certify model performance, statistical accuracy, standards compliance, legal compliance or current standards currency.
